title: The rail and the rows, joined — and amber means now
question: 1 and 3 combined: the whole day horizontally, the rows under it for what is left, and the amber marker saying where in the day you are. That also settles what the reserved light is FOR - it was never 'you used this area today', it is NOW. Two strengths of it.

options.label: A · the line fills up to now
options.thesis: The hours already spent are filled, brightest at the present and fading back into the morning, with a lit dot exactly at now. The day reads as something that is being used up.
options.viewport: A filled rail, four item dots, two rows left.
options.risk: The fill is the loudest thing on the home screen, and it moves all day. If amber ever means anything else, these two will argue.

options.label: B · only a dot at now
options.thesis: The same rail and the same rows, but nothing is filled - one lit dot travels along the day. The quietest reading of the same idea.
options.viewport: An empty rail with one lit dot.
options.risk: It says where you are and not how much of the day is gone, which is half of what a rail is good at.
